title: Primary Chat · QA asíncrono, repair y promoción sin cuello serial
mission: Extender owners CURRENT existentes para que entregables/candidatos tengan verificación asíncrona reusable sin bloquear innecesariamente la disponibilidad humana del resultado. Reutilizá worker pipeline, Guide/Integrator/Judge, portfolio/CURRENT, progress/widget owners, existing acceptance/promotion semantics y browser/served verification cuando corresponda. No crees QA scheduler, version registry, acceptance authority ni worker family paralelos.
definition_of_done: Leé PRIMARY_CHAT_IDEA_DELTA_ASYNC_QA_PROMOTION_20261001_V1.json y mapeá cada concepto a owners CURRENT exactos antes de implementar.
Definí un bloque universal VERIFY/QA invocable por packets/work graph existentes, con artifact/version refs, executable acceptance vectors, risk/depth and expected evidence.

Definí niveles de verificación baratos->caros: source/static, deterministic harness, integration, served-byte parity/cache semantics, representative interaction, visual/screenshot cuando aporte, full E2E/adversarial regression. El selector debe evitar browser/imagen cuando determinismo alcanza.
Permitir que candidate/preview sea visible mientras QA caro corre, siempre respetando existing safety/acceptance policy. QA_PENDING no equivale a promoted/current.
Exponer estado QA compacto al Primary Chat/action widget sólo cuando sea relevante: QA_PENDING, QA_PASS, QA_REPAIR_IN_PROGRESS, QA_BLOCKED, READY_TO_PROMOTE.

Un FAIL materializa bounded repair successor mediante Guide/Integrator/CURRENT; un PASS produce evidence/disposition y promotion-ready signal compatible con authority existente; BOUNDARY queda explícito.
Precompilar downstream: acceptance vectors, verifier packets, recovery refs and likely successor/repair paths pueden prepararse antes de que termine el producer para reducir idle gaps.

Para UI/browser, aceptación debe incluir served bytes/version/cache behavior además de source bytes. Incorporá como canary real el bug observado: main y gh-pages contenían progress-v1.js nuevo pero index servido referenciaba ./progress-v1.js estable y el usuario seguía viendo comportamiento viejo.

Resolver el served-asset cache/version canary en el owner de publicación existente, por ejemplo versionando/cache-busteando assets o mecanismo equivalente comprobable; no pedir al humano borrar cache como solución permanente.

Agregar harness que pruebe al menos: cheap PASS without browser; QA_PENDING candidate visible; visual/browser lane pending; FAIL -> repair successor; repaired candidate -> reverify; human-approval-required -> READY_TO_PROMOTE not auto-promote; auto-promotable policy path; stale served asset detection.
Persistí receipt con exact owner reuse map, implemented paths, tests and live/served evidence where capability exists. No declares browser PASS sin served interaction evidence.
truth_boundary: This job defines/reuses verification, candidate projection and repair/promotion flow only. CURRENT/portfolio remain work authority; existing acceptance semantics remain acceptance authority; QA evidence does not silently promote anything.
